newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen shares fall after Service drops bid.
newsitem.headline: Loewen shares fall after Service drops bid.

text.p: Shares in Canadian funeral home operator Loewen Group Inc sank on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Wednesday after Service Corp International dropped its US$2.9 billion takeover bid for the Vancouver-based company.
Loewen Group's stock was off 5.20 at 50.50 in early turnover of 381,000 shares.
The stock had hit a high of 58.75 during the takeover battle with Houston-based Service Corp.
Analysts said they expect Loewen shares to partly rebound after this morning's initial sell-off.
"They called off the offer last night so you are seeing the hedge boys unwinding. I think it will probably come back a bit," one stock analyst said.

In a statement released after stock markets closed on Tuesday, Service Corp cited Loewen's recent acquisition program, costs associated with Loewen's executive severance packages and uncertainties about divestitures that might be required to complete the transaction.
Service Corp's stock was up 2-3/8 at 30 on volume of 259,000 shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
